valuation_note: AMZN uses its filed combined cash-flow add-back, including property/equipment and content amortization, operating lease assets and other items. It is not pure D&A; DCF-implied EV/EBITDA is withheld. Debt includes carrying notes, short-term borrowings, finance leases and recognized financing obligations; the latter retain the filing’s rounded noncurrent amount. Operating leases enter net debt separately. Cash excludes restricted cash and marketable securities. Capex is gross cash PP&E purchases; noncash acquisitions and future commitments are not separately projected. GAAP operating income and taxes are retained. This simplified historical-ratio DCF is not Amazon-reported free cash flow; older debt rows are unavailable if full combined coverage is missing.
